title: No Stone Unturned
description: Find all twenty-four Stones of Barenziah scattered across Skyrim, have them appraised by Vex of the Thieves Guild, recover the Crown of Barenziah from Tolvald's Cave, and return it to earn the Prowler's Profit ability.

base_facts: I am a member of the Thieves Guild in Riften.
I appraise unusual gems and other valuables.

GEM_APPRAISED: I told the player the Unusual Gem is one of twenty-four Stones of Barenziah pried from Queen Barenziah's crown by a thief.
The stones are worthless individually but valuable as a complete set.
ALL_STONES_COLLECTED: The player has gathered all twenty-four Stones of Barenziah.
I revealed the Crown of Barenziah is in Tolvald's Cave and serves as a paragon for the Thieves Guild.
CROWN_RETURNED: The player returned the Crown of Barenziah to me.
I restored the crown to its original condition as a paragon for the Guild.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have restored the Crown of Barenziah to its original condition with all twenty-four stones returned to their rightful places.
The restored crown now serves as a paragon for the Thieves Guild, as it was always meant to.
The player has been granted Prowler's Profit, a permanent effect that significantly increases the chance of finding gems in randomized containers throughout Skyrim.
The long task of recovering the Stones of Barenziah and the Crown from Tolvald's Cave is finally complete.

base_facts: I am a Nord in Riften with connections to the Thieves Guild.
I know about appraising unusual goods.

FOUND_UNUSUAL_GEM: I told the player to show the Unusual Gem to Vex of the Thieves Guild.
I explained the player must become a full member of the Guild to speak with Vex.
I directed the player to find Brynjolf in Riften's marketplace to join the Guild.

beats.comment: Player finds an Unusual Gem and seeks an appraiser. Stage 5/10 triggers.
Vex identifies the gem as a Stone of Barenziah and explains the set of 24. Stage 20 trigger.
Player collects all 24 Stones and speaks to Vex, who reveals the crown location. Stage 30 trigger.
Player retrieves the Crown of Barenziah from Tolvald's Cave. Stage 40 trigger.
Player returns the Crown to Vex. Stage 50 trigger.
Quest finishes. Vex restores the crown, player receives Prowler's Profit. Stage 200 trigger.
